OUT: 'Steve has 5 [praxion_deaths]'

# Inventory, captured 2026-11-01 from a bot holding oak_log x5 and a pickaxe.
# 26.3 prints `count` before `Slot` and `id`; each stack is one `{...}` entry.
CMD: data get entity Bot1 Inventory
OUT: "Bot1 has the following entity data: [{count: 5, Slot: 0b, id: \"minecraft:oak_log\"}, {count: 1, Slot: 1b, id: \"minecraft:stone_pickaxe\"}]"

# An enchanted, renamed item: components nest braces, commas and a quoted
# string that itself contains a comma and a brace.
CMD: data get entity Bot1 Inventory
OUT: "Bot1 has the following entity data: [{components: {\"minecraft:enchantments\": {\"minecraft:sharpness\": 3}, \"minecraft:custom_name\": '\"Sword, of {Doom}\"'}, count: 1, Slot: 0b, id: \"minecraft:diamond_sword\"}]"
